get.description:
Liveness: the process is serving. Checks no dependency, so a database outage never
gets the API restarted in a loop.

delete.description:
Hard delete: the document, its pages, every revision (machine and human), timings, usability
events, jobs and queue rows, in one transaction (ON DELETE CASCADE), then its image directory.
Only a content-free audit row remains: entity id, action, actor, time. No filename, no text.

Refused (409) while jobs for the document are queued or running, unless force=true, and while
it has usability events, unless events_exported=true: export them first with
GET /exports/usability.csv?document_id=<id>, because deletion destroys them.
Response: counts only.

post.description:
Register a model version. Re-registering identical fields returns the existing row; the same
name with different fields is refused (409), because rows are frozen once they exist.

Queue OCR for a document. `Idempotency-Key` is required; repeating a request with the same
key returns the same job (200) instead of creating another (201).

200.description: The job this Idempotency-Key already created

get.description: Jobs, newest first, with progress and timings, for the queue view.

post.description:
Queue a new job for a failed job's document, model version, page range and text policy.

The failed job stays as it is, error included. The worker skips pages that already have a
machine revision, so the retry does only what is left. One retry per job: its idempotency key
is `retry:<job_id>`, so repeating the call returns the same retry job (200).

200.description: This job was already retried: the existing retry job

get.description: Everything the side-by-side view needs: image URL, the latest text, and the history.

200.description: The text equals the parent revision: nothing saved

post.description:
Store a batch of events; `server_ts` is set on receipt. A re-sent event (same session_id and
client_event_id) is ignored, so a retried batch cannot double-count.

get.description: kind=summary: one row per participant and page (times as above). kind=events: the raw events.
